svg.title: Sliding window: longest substring without repeats
svg.desc: The window slides over the string abcabcbb. right moves one character per step. When the new character was last seen inside the window, left jumps to one past that previous position. The window grows to abc (length 3), then keeps length 3 as bca, cab and abc, shrinks to cb and finally b. The best length is 3. A table of last-seen indices for a, b and c is updated at every step.
svg.text: Sliding window: longest substring without repeating characters
right moves every step; left only jumps forward, past the previous copy of a repeated character.
Every index enters the window once and leaves at most once, so the loop is O(n) overall.
